verdict.rationale: Paddle explicitly documents built-in multi-currency support for both payments and payouts ('customers purchase in their local currency and letting you get paid in yours'), plus localized pricing pages, 200+ country/currency support, and payout reconciliation reports that break down amounts in both transaction and balance currencies for transparency. As merchant of record, Paddle also handles tax compliance alongside FX, directly matching the story. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of FX conversion rates/margins used, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of settlement transparency beyond vendor docs.
